map.线性方程有自由变量时可能有多个正整数解；本页只在 ±8/±5/±3 的权重范围搜: A linear system with free variables can have several positive-integer solutions. map.化学方程式配平器。科学研究工具，采用标准科学公式，计算精准。: The Chemical Equation Balancer is an online tool in the scientific research domain. It uses standard scientific formulas for accurate calculation.
map.化学方程式配平（本页代码口径，矩阵零空间算法）：按元素×物种构建原子守恒矩阵（反: Chemical equation balancing (per this page's code, matrix null-space algorithm): an atom-conservation matrix is built over elements × species (reactants positive, products negative); RREF finds the null-space basis and LCM/GCD reduction is applied. A unique basis gives the smallest integer coefficients. With multiple basis vectors, weights are enumerated within ±8 (2 vectors)/±5 (3)/±3 (≥4), taking the all-positive solution with the smallest maximum coefficient and labelling it non-unique; a miss in that range does not prove the equation unsolvable and does not guarantee a global minimum. Validation requires exactly one equals sign with non-empty sides; unknown symbols and RREF-proven absence of a non-zero solution are reported explicitly.
